senses.gloss:
r. 4th cl. (ईर्) युपीर (युप्यति)
To confuse, to perplex.

mn. (-पः-पं)
1 A sacrificial post, a pillar usually made of bambus, or the wood of the Khadira, to which the victim at a sacrifice is bound.
2 A trophy, a column erected in honour of a victory.
E.
यु to bind (the victim), प Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
A wooden ring on the top of a sacrificial post, or according to some authorities, an iron ring at its base.
E.
यूप the post, and कटक् a ring, &c.

m. (-र्णः)
A part of a sacrificial post sprinkled with ghee.
E.
यूप the post, and कर्ण the ear.

m. (-द्रुः)
The Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.)
E.
यूप a sacrificial post, and द्रु a tree; the wood of this tree being especially fit for the sacrificial post; also यूपद्रुम m. (-मः.)

m. (-क्ष्यः)
A bird.
E.
यूप a sacrificial post, put for any post, and लक्ष्य an aim; a sort of net being made about a post, on which birds may alight.

m. (-ग्रः)
The top of the sacrificial post.
E.
यूप as above, and अग्र top.

m. (-यः)
The ceremony of erecting the sacrificial post.
E.
यूप a sacrificial post, and उच्छ्रय elevation.
